facts.fact: WHO's Togo office reports that in 2024 it supported a national diagnostic of the birth and death registration system, which produced a national roadmap for the digitalisation of CRVS and a multisectoral task force to harmonise practice.

systems.country_label: système national d'enregistrement des faits d'état civil et de production de statistiques vitales (CRVS)
systems.tiers: national; a roadmap for its digitalisation was drawn up in 2024, no deployment stated
named as a digital tool for cause-of-death coding with the adoption of ICD-11; not stated as deployed
